quote: Given a financial news headline depicting a market event, an LLM is tasked with generating two forward counterfactuals—an opportunity counterfactual and a risk counterfactual.

We propose FIN-FORCE ... a novel benchmark to support LLM forward counterfactual generation in finance. ... The following models are tasked with generating a single risk and a single opportunity counterfactual from each headline in FIN-FORCE.
We propose FIN-FORCE -FINancial FORward Counterfactual Evaluation, a novel benchmark to support LLM forward counterfactual generation in finance.
outputs: risk counterfactual and opportunity counterfactual sentences per headline

quote: Fluency—naturalness and grammaticality of counterfactuals, via perplexity […] Therefore, for our task, we build on perplexity for fluency evaluation by focusing on ∆ Perplexity […] In place of validity, similarity, and diversity, we introduce two new metrics—forwardcompatibility and directionality

We build on perplexity for fluency evaluation by focusing on Δ Perplexity ... We also introduce two new metrics—forward-compatibility and directionality ... The scores ... reflect the proportion (in percentages) of counterfactuals meeting the forward-compatibility and directionality criteria respectively.

We build on perplexity for fluency evaluation by focusing on ∆ Perplexity - the difference between the average perplexity of all counterfactuals and all original headlines... we introduce two new metrics—forward-compatibility and directionality, which are better aligned with FIN-FORCE's objectives.
Each counterfactual is assessed using an LLMas-a-judge framework […]

Each generated counterfactual is presented to the LLM one at a time for evaluation, and separate runs are performed for assessing forward-compatibility and directionality. ... We use GPT-4o as the LLM judge.
Each counterfactual is assessed using an LLM-as-a-judge framework... we validate the LLM judgments through a human-LLM agreement study
methods: LLM-as-a-judge prompting for forward-compatibility and directionality

quote: To ensure robustness, we validate the LLM judgments through a human-LLM agreement study with 500 random samples. This study compares LLM labels with those from independent human annotators

A total of five human contributors ... participated in the benchmark annotation ... We conducted a human-LLM agreement study ... to evaluate whether the LLM judge aligns with the preferences of proficient human annotators when using the criteria of forward-compatibility and directionality.
Five human contributors, all based in Singapore and recruited from reputable research institutions, participated in the benchmark annotation... we conducted a human-LLM agreement study
guideline: Each counterfactual must be assessed [...] using the two evaluation criteria: Forward-Compatibility and Directionality. [Annotators] evaluate the counterfactual [...]
Annotators evaluated counterfactuals against forward-compatibility and directionality guidelines, marking each as TRUE or FALSE.

Annotators evaluated whether a headline describes a financial market event based on Event Status and Material Relevance criteria; for counterfactuals, they assessed Forward-Compatibility and Directionality using detailed guidelines.
